headline: try needs a function returning the same failure kind
reason: try works on a Result in a function returning Result, or on an Option in a function returning Option; otherwise handle the failure with case (reference 8.3).

primary.label: try needs a function returning the same failure kind

headline: a result isn't used
reason: A result that isn't Unit and isn't used is an error (reference 6.1).

headline: case doesn't cover every possible value; missing: BadLevels(..)
reason: The arms must cover every possible value (reference 7.2).

headline: values of different types are combined
reason: Comparing or combining values of different types is an error (reference 3).
